reason: Checked the sheet against the three rules it cites (CONTEXT l.2407 L9, l.2502 R12-A3, l.2664 R13-A1) and against the code. It is a faithful mechanical reading and adds no rule. (1) The CODES and UNIT mapping match ladder_watch.py unit_status/ref_verdict (POS_MIN 0.955, NEG_MAX 0.953; ERROR -> NEU; AMBIGUOUS -> no UP). (2) The D1-2 string matches runtime_ledger.divins_gate() exactly ('insertion gate 8.0 h did NOT fire (L <= x h)'); 'UNPROVEN' and 'MAY have fired' are correctly excluded. (3) The L_hi clock matches the poll.log submit dates (e 21:15:23.887, a 21:17:47.170, d 21:38:33.837, b 00:05:50.347) + 8 h / 9 h. Truncating to the second makes it conservative by < 1 s, and the ledger adds 210 s per failed attempt, so deferring to the ledger text is right. (4) The D1-1 cross-knob condition for e ('where scored'; an ERROR passes) and the tie order a > d > e both follow L9 (class A, then fewer knobs, then earlier submit). (5) B-1/B-2 reproduce L5v2's BLOCKED rule and its tie order. (6) STEP 0(i) can be checked: watch.log writes 'S0 <folder>: ...' and 'EVENT n | ...' lines. The watcher folder does not exist yet at 02:00Z; it is due by 04:10Z. All four refs were still PENDING at the 01:59:36Z header. No submit, no build, no mechanism, so there is no R8, byte-identity or runtime exposure. Defects are wording only. (a) D1-1 says 'V* = the highest display' but must say the highest display among the refs that MEET the D1-1 conditions. Example: a P5 0.956 with L_hi 9.2 h and d P5 0.955 with L_hi 8.5 h. L9 gives V* = d, but the literal sheet gives a, and its D1-3 bullet 'a P5 with L_hi > 9.0 h' then reads as a conflict. This world has probability < 0.5%, but the sheet claims to be mechanical. (b) STEP 0(iii) says 'after probes 39-41' where R13-A1(4) says 39-42. The sheet's wording is the accurate one at D1; log the difference as a correction. (c) STEP 0 has no timeout if a ref stays PENDING. This is harmless because the tick waits for probe 42 and the deadline is 29 Sep 20:00Z. On value: the sheet claims no score. Moving a final on a one-embryo public display is L9's choice, already made and hedged by #38, and not something this sheet introduces. The priors (D1-1 0.20-0.35) are at the optimistic end of the ladder skeptic's 0.05-0.15 per single, but they are plausible for 3 correlated refs from 15th of 100 in the 0.954 block, and they drive no decision.
fix: Adopt as READ SHEET v1 part 1 with three edits. (1) D1-1: 'V* = the highest display among the refs in {a, d, e} that satisfy the D1-1 conditions (P5, COMPLETE, L_hi <= 9.0 h, and for e the a/d clause); ties a > d > e'. In D1-3, reword the first bullet to 'no P5 ref satisfies D1-1 (e.g. every P5 has L_hi > 9.0 h or UNPROVEN)'. (2) STEP 0(iii): keep 'after probes 39-41' and add '(corrects R13-A1(4) 39-42: probe 42 is still pending at D1)'. (3) STEP 0: if a ref is still PENDING at 09:40Z (watcher HARD_CAP), read D1 with that ref as not scored and note it. Also add one line: before the read, confirm the ladder_watch folder exists (it is absent at 02:00Z; start by 04:10Z), because otherwise the A-only extension is dropped by construction.
realistic_gain: Zero direct score. It removes misread risk at the ~05:00-05:40Z D1 read (a wrong V* or a wrong A-only call would put an ineligible file in the finals). The main value is the V* scoping fix, in a world of probability < 0.5%.
